title: AISD Is Heading for State Takeover. Here's What Happened to Houston.
slideTitles: AISD Is Heading for State Takeover. Here's What Happened to Houston.
Austin’s ratings follow its poverty map.

states.body: Every square is an AISD campus open this year, by its 2025-26 rating.
20 of them for three straight years.
District-wide, 36 gained a grade; D/F fell from 41 to 31.

states.lead: Nine more are one F away.
states.body: Six carry a closed school's record. Last year only three were at four.
6 declined; 1 was unchanged. Above the line means a higher STAAR pass rate in 2026.

states.lead: Two crossed. Amber is one F away.
states.body: Six amber campuses closed; their records moved to the schools that took their students.
Each dot is a campus, brighter the poorer it is.

states.lead: Same dots, now colored by rating.
states.body: TEA accountability grades, A through F.

states.lead: The F campuses trace east Austin.
The A campuses sit on the west side.
